assessments.reasoning: LaTeX3 Project governing text r1, event 88b870ac290c45d483e55a1de1f71346. Whole and [5345,18225) digests match. The cited span includes both clause 6 and “Derived Works That Are Not Replacements”. The claim's applicability condition preserves that exception.

limitations: Application depends on the Work, maintainer status, intended replacement use and any applicable component exemption in the copyright notice. Satisfying 6(d) alone does not establish compliance with all terms.
reasoning: Where 1.3c clause 6(d) applies, a non-Current Maintainer distributing a Derived Work must provide the complete unmodified Work or sufficient information to obtain it. The later non-replacement provision expressly limits when that duty arises.
